evidence.positive:
On the running build (demo-demo, admin API staging, cases started via POST /api/app-launch, PROCEDURE_START posted via /api/admin/events/category-event, prompt read from rule_fired_results.prompt): Hysterectomy case 18534 with cefazolin charted 90 min before case start and no metronidazole fired with title 'Administer MetroNIDAZOLE; Redose CeFAZolin' and description 'Prior to incision for hysterectomy, recommend ceFAZolin and metroNIDAZOLE.
MetroNIDAZOLE not yet administered.
CeFAZolin administered at 18:49 (> 1 hour before incision). Recommend repeating the full dose.' (ticket example 1). Knee arthroscopy 73211 with cefazolin at -90 min fired 'Redose CeFAZolin' with the early-redose line (example 2). Knee arthroscopy 34080 with nothing given fired 'Administer CeFAZolin' / '... recommend ceFAZolin. Patient received no perioperative antibiotics.' (example 3). Missed-abortion case 48437 with doxycycline (NO_REDOSE) at -90 min fired 'Evaluate Doxycycline Status' with 'Doxycycline administered at 18:51 (> 1 hour before incision). No redose suggested due to potential toxicity. Consult with pharmacy.' Open biliary case 82192 (two surviving options) with metronidazole at -30 min fired generic title 'Administer Antibiotics' with both option descriptions, each 'Patient received metroNIDAZOLE. not yet administered.', joined by
OR
. Case-stop compliance: CLOSE_APP on 73211 after adding an on-time cefazolin dose scored alert-compliance true.
evidence.negative: Knee arthroscopy 00097 with cefazolin charted 30 min before case start (inside the 1h lookback) did not fire: /api/admin/rule/evaluations/not-fired recorded 'Procedure candidates were given.' and the app log showed 'Rule evaluated: a-incomplete-antibiotic-pathway -> false Procedure candidates were given.'. Knee arthroscopy 91109 with only a stale unrecommended antibiotic (azithromycin at -90 min) did not fire: not-fired reason 'No suitable antibiotics given.' and no 'Patient received no perioperative antibiotics' alert. Case-stop compliance: CLOSE_APP on hysterectomy 18534 with only the stale cefazolin dose scored alert-compliance false.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit's (6810750a1) IncompleteAntibioticPathwayRule in the app container (lombok logger written out, plus one INFO line in createPrompt logging the rendered title/description because the app never logs prompt text), backed up the seven shipped class files to /tmp/shipped-backup and md5-recorded them, swapped the pre-fix classes into /app/classes and restarted the container. Re-ran the stale-cefazolin knee scenario (case 02020, cefazolin at -90 min): the pre-fix rule rendered title 'Administer CeFAZolin' and description 'Patient received no antibiotics. Prior to incision for Knee Arthroscopy, recommend CeFAZolin' (the old nothing-given wording for a dose that was actually on board) — logged as 'Pre-fix rule prompt rendered: title=Administer CeFAZolin description=Patient received no antibiotics. ...'. The event then 500'd with NoSuchFieldError because the shipped compliance evaluator reads the new PERIOPERATIVE_WINDOW field at save time, so no fired row persisted for that case; the red behaviour is the rendered prompt in the log. Restored the shipped classes from the backup, verified all seven md5sums match the pre-swap values, restarted, and re-ran the same scenario (case 21535): 'Redose CeFAZolin' with the early-redose line returned and no pre-fix marker line appeared.

red_check_signature: Pre-fix rule prompt rendered: title=Administer CeFAZolin description=Patient received no antibiotics.
caveats: Multi-word procedure names render mid-sentence with only the first letter lowered: 'Prior to incision for knee Arthroscopy' and 'for billary Tract (open procedure)', where the ticket example reads 'knee arthroscopy'. Cosmetic, worth a follow-up.
Demo's tall-man drug labels render as 'ceFAZolin' / 'metroNIDAZOLE' in body text (only the first letter is lowered); the ticket examples use plain lowercase names.

EARLY_DISCRETION wording was not exercised at runtime: demo's only first-tier vancomycin pathway (p-urology) has no procedure type, and reaching a discretion drug otherwise needs allergy-driven fallback. Covered by unit tests only.
Acuity- and qualifier-scoped (legacy) rendering was not exercised; demo has no such pathway rows and the spec declares that rendering unchanged.

Medication administrations were inserted by SQL (order + administration rows) with the patient cache evicted, since the demo tenant's user administration endpoint cannot write; procedure start was posted as a manual category event.
The pre-fix class swap could not persist its firing (NoSuchFieldError from the shipped compliance evaluator), so the red evidence is the rendered prompt in the log, not a stored row.

automation.assessment: IncompleteAntibioticPathwayRuleTest already covers every state, the six ticket examples, lookback-in-minutes, acronym/tall-man names and the OR join; AntibioticProphylaxisComplianceEvaluatorTest covers the perioperative-dose scoring change. qa-suite has no coverage of this rule at all, so nothing proves the wiring end to end (lookback CSV redose column -> AntibioticLookbackService -> rule -> stored prompt). Worth locking in a small supplemental API-level family using the staging path used here.
proposed_tests: qa-suite supplemental: hysterectomy case with cefazolin charted 90 min before start and no metronidazole; PROCEDURE_START yields title 'Administer MetroNIDAZOLE; Redose CeFAZolin' and an early-redose line naming '> 1 hour before incision'.

qa-suite supplemental: knee arthroscopy with cefazolin 30 min before start; PROCEDURE_START records not-fired 'Procedure candidates were given.' (with a sibling flip at 90 min that fires, as the can-it-fail check).
qa-suite supplemental: knee arthroscopy with only a stale azithromycin dose; the rule abstains ('No suitable antibiotics given.') and no 'no perioperative antibiotics' alert is produced.
qa-suite supplemental: no-redose drug (doxycycline on p-missed-abortion-first-trimester) 90 min early yields 'Evaluate Doxycycline Status' and the toxicity/pharmacy line.
qa-suite supplemental: case-stop compliance flips from false to true for the stale-cefazolin knee case once an on-time cefazolin dose is charted before CLOSE_APP.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: Against the running main build, a hysterectomy with cefazolin given 90 minutes before case start and no metronidazole fired 'Administer MetroNIDAZOLE; Redose CeFAZolin' with the per-drug lines from the ticket, and the no-redose, nothing-given and two-option (OR) scenarios rendered as specified.
Negative: A cefazolin dose inside its lookback left the rule silent with 'Procedure candidates were given.', and a stale unrecommended antibiotic alone abstained instead of claiming no perioperative antibiotics were received.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix rule class into the container made the same stale-cefazolin case render the old 'Administer CeFAZolin / Patient received no antibiotics' wording, and restoring the shipped class (checksums verified) brought back 'Redose CeFAZolin'.

Automation: Unit coverage is thorough but qa-suite has none for this rule, so a small supplemental API-level family covering the redose, within-lookback silence, stale-unrecommended abstain and case-stop compliance flip is proposed.
